📖 About the Game

A rogue astronomical event has inverted reality: a celestial Supermassive Whitehole expels matter and exerts gravitational pull across the cosmos. Navigate through dynamic warping spacetime, manage player stamina, and survive the gravitational pull of the cosmic phenomenon.

Developed in C++ for the 1-bit monochrome Arduboy handheld and compiled to WebAssembly/JavaScript for browser emulation on itch.io.
